content: Spouses under statutory community property owned apartment and parking space in Catania. Following 2006 separation, husband transferred bare ownership of his undivided share to daughter retaining habitation right, while wife sought division and compensation for exclusive use by husband and daughter. Articles 177, 191, 194 Italian Civil Code govern legal community dissolution, which occurs upon separation finalization. The issue concerned whether division could proceed despite habitation right, and whether compensation owed from separation date or division request date. Plaintiff waived accounting claim during proceedings, causing cessation of that dispute aspect. Court-appointed expert determined apartment (127.17 sqm) barely sufficient for small three-room unit, making convenient division impossible. Habitation right not obstacle to sale—convertible to monetary equivalent per Supreme Court precedent when indivisibility prevents physical separation. Market value €98,510.00. Compensation for exclusive occupation due from division request filing date (2015), not separation finalization date, per Article 1148—moment when restitution debt arises for good faith possessor. Auction sale ordered with costs reserved for final judgment.
